description: Annual % change in house prices for one European country, quarter by quarter, for all dwellings (default), new or existing homes. Answers "are house prices rising in Portugal or the Netherlands" for buyers, movers and investors. Source: Eurostat dataset prc_hpi_q (house price index). Prices in euro are not given, only rates of change; latest quarter is often provisional. (cost: 1 credit)

geo.description: string, required, 2-letter Eurostat country code (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, EL = Greece) or country name; EU27_2020, EA (euro area), EA21, EA20 also accepted. EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only (no UK)

n.description: integer, optional, most recent quarters, 1-100, default 8

purchase.description: string, optional: 'all' (default), 'new' or 'existing' dwellings (TOTAL, DW_NEW, DW_EXST)

name: eu_house_price_growth
